table_description: Dimension table describing marketing promotions. Each row is one promotion with date range, discount percentage, channels used, and cost. Promotions link to sales fact tables via the PROMO_SK columns (SS_PROMO_SK, CS_PROMO_SK, WS_PROMO_SK). Used to measure campaign effectiveness and ROI.
use_cases: Promotion ROI analysis (revenue uplift vs promotion cost)
Channel effectiveness: which channel drove more sales per promotion
Discount depth impact on sales volume
Active promotions at any point in time
Response rate comparison across promotion types
data_quality_notes: P_CHANNEL_* columns are 'Y' or 'N' flags — not booleans. There are 8 channel columns.
P_DISCOUNT_ACTIVE is 'Y' or 'N' — whether the discount is currently active.
P_COST is the total cost of running the promotion (marketing spend), not the discount amount.
P_RESPONSE_TARGET is an integer from 1-3 indicating the intended audience size.
Promotions with P_PROMO_SK = NULL in fact tables represent no promotion applied.
P_START_DATE_SK and P_END_DATE_SK define the promotion window — join to DATE_DIM for date filtering.

table_columns.name: P_PROMO_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by sales facts as PROMO_SK.

table_columns.name: P_START_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. Promotion start date.

table_columns.name: P_END_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: FK to DATE_DIM. Promotion end date.

table_columns.name: P_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: FK to ITEM. The item this promotion applies to.

table_columns.name: P_COST
table_columns.description: Total marketing cost to run this promotion.

table_columns.name: P_CHANNEL_DMAIL
table_columns.description: 'Y' if promotion used direct mail channel.

table_columns.name: P_CHANNEL_DEMO
table_columns.description: 'Y' if promotion used product demo channel.

table_columns.name: P_CHANNEL_DETAILS
table_columns.description: Free text description of promotion channel details.

table_columns.name: P_DISCOUNT_ACTIVE
table_columns.description: 'Y' if the promotion discount is currently active, 'N' otherwise.
